notes.title: 日本語のローカライズが完了しました！| Japanese Translation Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you are doing well, the Japanese version of Dab On Darkness is here! If your steam language is set to Japanese, it should automatically be downloaded, if not, then right click the game in your steam library, go to properties, and select Japanese from the languages tab! You may need to restart steam to see the option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945854/98eae0933367a3aeee936cbf95f630923b1d99ae.jpg[/img]

I hope this translation will be helpful! Please let me know your thoughts on it. Take care and have a wonderful day.

Also, I'm running an anime kickstarter based off of Dab on Darkness! Featuring Kard Sens! Check it out here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945854/159970369645ed56add8a84b8f8f1c278f0b6f44.jpg[/img]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sigyaad/an-anime-about-overcoming-your-inner-darkness

notes.title: Dab On Darkness Reboot Released And ON SALE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Kard Sens is back and is better then ever in this new reboot of Dab On Darkness released a few months ago! Just look at that glow up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945854/3c2eaac8608acd8c3951457f9ae5222b9ec0dbab.png[/img]

The game is called My Inner Darkness Is A Hot Anime Girl, it's a 3D RPG with surreal designs and it features a way more indepth look into a lot of the stuff Dab on Darkness talks about! So if you found the advice in Dab on Darkness helpful you will LOVE the way Inner Darkness presents itself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945854/cdf491e65e636cf622d721cd810743e9e8e13c19.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945854/7fe0c76216d61b4715a030664666bee070fa3189.jpg[/img]

You can check the game out HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753050/My_Inner_Darkness_Is_A_Hot_Anime_Girl/
